title: Pin ccp16 version fields before inequality
description: The Rust ccp16_desync_vectors semantics test uses assert_ne!(v["version"], v["alternate_version"]). serde_json indexing returns Value::Null for a missing key, so deletion or renaming of either vector field can pass because Null differs from the remaining value. Assert both fields are present and integer-valued before comparing them.
close_reason: Fixed: multi_root_version_conflict_vector_semantics now binds version and alternate_version via .as_u64().expect() before assert_ne!, closing the Null-vacuity hole (missing/renamed/typedrifted field previously passed assert_ne vacuously). Verified: cargo test -p lichen-core --test ccp16_desync_vectors 6/6 green; real-Rust mutation harness (temp crate, vector copy with alternate_version deleted) now FAILS at the presence assert while the OLD assert passed the same mutated JSON. clippy -D warnings + fmt clean. 3x delegated kimi-k3 review (correctness/security/edge): PASS x3, zero findings. Reviewer cross-checked: C and Python consumers already pin presence; sibling lichen-rpl consumer has no vacuity pattern; u64 is correct (RFC 6550 version is unsigned 8-bit, as_i64 would accept spec-invalid negatives).
